text:
Noah: Heads-up: marketing wants a simpler hero for the blog that communicates the core benefit in one line + chart. We're iterating away from complex multi-axes. Any objections?

Carla: Fine by me. Suggest a log-scaled x-axis for latency so we can show both 50ms and 400ms models without compressing space. Keep cost linear on y.

Ibrahim: Simpler hero + a clarifying caption should do it. For supporting visuals: 1) traffic split diagram, 2) short table comparing p50/p95 and normalized cost.

Tess: Messaging: "Faster where it matters, cheaper everywhere else." Short and punchy.

Noah: Good. Also, let's ensure the blog includes a small appendix with raw benchmark methodology and links to the CSV. Engineering will ask.

bench-bot: Artifact published: s3://redwood-bench/2026-11-14_slim-hero/report.html

Carla: I've exported a mock hero at 1200x600 (drive link in doc). Will tweak tick formatting for log-scale.

Ibrahim: I'll assemble the p50/p95 table and cost column. Use sample numbers for the mock.

Tess: I'll test the headline variants with a short internal slack poll after this thread.

Noah: Action: Carla finalize SVG, Ibrahim finish table, Tess run poll. Wrap by EOD.

bench-bot: Next run scheduled 2026-11-21_slim-hero.

Noah: Thanks team.
